scheme_notes.text: Aadharshila (National Curriculum for ECCE for Children from Three to Six Years, 2024) and NCF-FS cover the three preschool years of the Foundational Stage.
Development domains: physical/motor, cognitive, socio-emotional-ethical, cultural/artistic, communication and early language, literacy and numeracy.

15 minutes of child-facing screen per day is a product cap, well inside the WHO 2019 ceiling of 1 hour total sedentary screen time for ages 3-4. WHO's under-5 guideline does not cover age 5-6; same cap applied by product choice.
